title: A split order stays shipped after one seller's transfer is fully reversed from the Stripe dashboard
detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 in the scan-six read of LIVE-705 (dafcddd). rollUpSplitOrder (lib/commerce/fulfilment.ts) recomputes an order's shipping state only when a seller's share moves. recordTransferReversed (lib/commerce/transfers.ts, the transfer.reversed webhook) can set a share to `reversed` after every other share is delivered, and nothing re-rolls the order. THE FIX: call the roll-up from recordTransferReversed when a row becomes reversed.

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-six adversarial read of the 2026-09-28..30 merges

verify.note: Fails until recordTransferReversed re-rolls the order.
